225ad7aa7d2f.title: XSS Vulnerability in Fact Value
225ad7aa7d2f.reason: html`` (core/html.ts) escapes every interpolated value (&, <, >, quotes) unless it is already SafeHtml; a fact value is a plain string, so <script> or onerror=... show as text.

24ed3b3a6d22.title: Missing Error Handling
24ed3b3a6d22.reason: deleteFact awaits this.request, which throws on any non-2xx answer with the server's message; the caller (factDeleteLater) shows the error and puts the fact back.

6d61dfc6445c.title: Potential XSS via URL Attribute
6d61dfc6445c.reason: valueView only makes a link when the value starts with http:// or https:// (checked with a regex), and the attribute is escaped by html``; javascript: values stay plain text.

baf6a1a55025.title: Potential Data Loss in Truncation
baf6a1a55025.reason: Cutting is the point: the result must fit the caller's tool-result budget. It says how many characters were left out, and the cursor lets the model read the next page; nothing is lost from the stored step.

f1a327c81c27.title: SQL Injection Vulnerability
f1a327c81c27.reason: format! only inserts COLUMNS (a constant) and the column name from the Scope enum ("project_id" or "chat_id", both literals); every value is bound with ?. flag_missing_path binds chat_id and path too.
